title: PSG take on Barcelona in 2026 Champions League clash amid French protests
description:
In a test for both teams and the strained French police, Paris Saint-Germain hosts Barcelona in a Champions League showcase against the backdrop of violent unrest across France.
PSG and Barcelona head the standings, though Liverpool or even surprising Stuttgart could end Tuesday on top of the table.
The game, which will need a robust security presence, takes place in a very different context to when PSG beat Manchester City 4-2 away last week.
What began in France as protests against school conditions has expanded to include a wide range of other groups and causes. There have been violent clashes, fires and looting.
An emergency meeting with top government officials on Monday confirmed PSG-Barcelona and other soccer games in European competitions can go ahead after the possibility of calling off games and other big events was discussed.
